rules.rationale: Base equation defining the integerVals predicate on the empty ValSeq; it names the input-domain test and does not model an execution step.
Constructor-recursive equation defining integerVals on a nonempty ValSeq from isInt of the head and integerVals of the tail.
Guarded base equation defining scanBad to return its accumulator when the scanned integer is nonpositive.
Guarded recurrence defining scanBad for a positive integer by updating the counter and recurring on the decimal quotient.
Unconditional equation defining the named scanNumber summary with a conditional expression.
Guarded equation defining appendCandidate's append branch for an integer whose scanBad summary is zero.
Complementary guarded equation defining appendCandidate's unchanged-accumulator branch for a nonzero scanBad summary.
Base equation defining the collect fold over an empty ValSeq.
Constructor-recursive equation defining collect by applying appendCandidate to the head and folding over the tail.
Base equation defining afterValue on an empty remaining sequence.
Constructor-recursive equation defining afterValue by carrying the current head while consuming the remaining sequence.
Base equation defining afterNumber on an empty remaining sequence.
Constructor-recursive equation defining afterNumber from scanNumber of each integer head.
Base equation defining afterBad on an empty remaining sequence.
Constructor-recursive equation defining afterBad from scanBad of each integer head.
